rules.statement: A court investigating title in a partition action must consider the entirety of the evidence as to the devolution of title of the parties to the land sought to be partitioned.
rules.supporting_quote: Therefore, it is clear that the learned District Judge had carefully considered the entirety of the evidence as to the devolution of title of the parties to the land sought to be partitioned as required under Section 25(1) of the Partition Law.
rules.statute_citation_verbatim: Section 25 (1) of the Partition Law No.21 of 1977 (as amended)
